known.summary: `posixLiteral` puts the value between single quotes, but it does not escape a single quote in the value. `statusLineCommand` builds the shell command of the Claude Code statusline from the Bun path and the statusline script path, so a path with a `'`, from the home folder or from BUN_INSTALL, ends the quote, and the rest of the path runs as shell code each time Claude Code draws the statusline (CWE-78, command injection). The pull request adds claudeRuntime.ts: the base has no such file and no statusline command builder.
